evidence_chain.link: Marfan syndrome is characterized by bilateral inferior lens dislocation.
Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is also characterized by lens dislocation, but the specific type and location may differ.

ranked_facts.why: The presence of bilateral inferior lens dislocation is a key feature of Marfan syndrome, which is supported by the provided chunks.

evidence_chain.link: Marfan syndrome is characterized by tall stature with arachnodactyly.
Ehlers-Danlos syndrome may also present with tall stature, but the presence of arachnodactyly is more specific to Marfan syndrome.

ranked_facts.why: The presence of tall stature with arachnodactyly is a key feature of Marfan syndrome, which is supported by the provided chunks.
